title: Holding More Than One Northbeam Credit Account
content:
A customer may hold more than one account of the Northbeam Store Credit and Financing Accounts range, since a promotional financing account sits alongside a card and a business line sits alongside a consumer card.

## The charter of holdings

1. A second account of the same credit product is never opened while one already stands with its application awaiting a decision, or standing active, delinquent or suspended.
2. A profile holds at most one consumer card and one promotional account at a time, and a business profile at most one net account and one fleet line, so 2 accounts of the range are the most that stand on one profile at any time.
3. A closed account does not block a fresh application, and the earlier record stays on file.

## What may stand together

| Profile | What may stand at one time |
|---|---|
| A household profile | one consumer card — the Northbeam Store Card, the Northbeam Store Card Plus or the Northbeam Signature Rewards Card — together with one Northbeam Deferred Interest Promotion Account |
| A business profile | one Northbeam Business Net Thirty Account together with one Northbeam Business Fleet Line of Credit |

## How the second-account test is made

The test is made on the profile's own account records, read before the account is opened, and not on what the customer says they hold. Two things are compared: the profile the record belongs to and the credit product it names. Where a record of that same profile and that same product stands with its application awaiting a decision, or stands active, delinquent or suspended, the product is already held and a second is not opened. A different application day written on the record, or a different limit, does not make it a different holding.

## Points of judgement

- A profile whose Northbeam Store Card Plus stands active applies again for the Northbeam Store Card Plus: that second account is not opened, because a record of the same product stands in one of the four states named.
- A profile whose earlier Northbeam Store Card stands closed applies for a Northbeam Store Card: the closed record does not block the application, and it stays on file after the new account is opened.
- A household profile holding an active Northbeam Signature Rewards Card applies for a Northbeam Deferred Interest Promotion Account: these are a consumer card and a promotional account, one of each, so both may stand at the same time.
